steps.what: List open receiving and shipping movements
Supervise workers receiving and shipping products
Note testing or storing exceptions on the floor
Sign the shift supervision note
File the signed shift supervision note
outputs: filed copy of signed shift supervision note v1

tasks.design: A job lists open receiving and shipping movements in {OPS_SYSTEM}. The manager supervises the workers on the floor, including storing and testing. A later job files the signed note in {DOCS}. The job does not watch named staff and does not score them.
tasks.previous_blocker: Open movements were copied onto a sheet before the walk.
tasks.enabler_now: Status and location are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: Supervision still means being on the floor.
tasks.human_edge: The manager sees the work the record does not show.
tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the floor, not on assembling the movement list.

evidence.claim: The executive digest says logistics planning is configured route and stock tools, and the manager decides.
Digest [S10] says no significant decision about a person is made solely by automation.
Digest [S11] says allocation or performance scoring of people is Annex III point 4(b).
Digest [S14] says works-council consent covers staff data and monitoring.

assumptions: Movement identifier, status, location, and shipment identifier are stored on the operations record. The operations record produces them. A blank field stays blank and is shown as a gap.
Native configuration of the operations record is used before any custom code.
Only the version the manager signed is filed or sent.
The job lists movements, not named staff. Consent for monitoring is a separate decision.
unknowns: Who else must see the signed note.
research_questions: How often the required field is blank.

already_counted.description: Half the remaining supervision time is still the manager on the floor with the workers.

incremental.description: Refresh movement status and location when the operations layout changes, and drop a list the manager has not used.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The low end assumes many movements have a blank status. The high end assumes status and location are stored. Upkeep is already taken off the central saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Plan warehouse safety and security programs.

tasks.human_edge: The manager decides which activities to run.

ambition.what: Set a safety activity the week the incident is stored.

tasks.altitude: The manager spends the week on the program, not on collecting incidents.

steps.what: List equipment due for inspection
Inspect physical conditions of warehouse equipment
Order testing or repairs from that inspection
Sign the repair order
Place only the signed repair order

tasks.enabler_now: Equipment identifier and last test date are already stored.
tasks.still_hard: The condition is still judged in person.

reach: A warehouse lead follows only the assignment the manager signed.
A carrier is told only the rate the manager signed.
